description: This file contains unit tests for matrix reaction helper functions such as building reaction content, summarizing reactions, selecting reaction event ids for a user, and extracting annotations. It verifies the correctness of these functions implemented in 'reaction-common.js'.

methods.name: buildMatrixReactionContent
methods.description: Creates the reaction content object associating an event ID with a key emoji.

methods.name: buildMatrixReactionRelationsPath
methods.description: Constructs the URL path for reaction relations in a Matrix room.

methods.name: summarizeMatrixReactionEvents
methods.description: Aggregates reaction events by emoji key and unique sender count.

methods.name: selectOwnMatrixReactionEventIds
methods.description: Filters reaction event IDs that match the current user's sender and key.

methods.name: extractMatrixReactionAnnotation
methods.description: Extracts annotation details from a reaction relation if it is an 'm.annotation' type.
